Product description

One pack to carry everything.

Not only a tactical backpack but also a daily backpack or a gym backpack, unisex

  • Waterproof fabric and Rip Proof
  • All compartments have two-way openings,180 Degree Openings for easy packing
  • The army backpack has a side, front, and bottom compression strap load system. The bottom straps allow you to hang the sleeping bag or tent.
  • Easily holds 2 pairs of trainers/footwear, towel, gym clothes, meal prep, and small training tools
  • 2 side cup holders capable of holding 750ml water bottle

LHI Comes in Three Sizes: 45L, 35L and 25L, Discover Which Bag is Best for You.

Previous page
Next page

Features：

Patch Strip

  • Patch strips to add any patch to customize your bag.
  • Each bag will come with a US patch (please check the pockets of the backpack carefully)

Molle System

  • Molle webbing on the front and either side allow for hanging your gear. and make it the perfect base for a bug-out bag.

High-quality zipper

  • Each pocket comes with two extra zipper pulls

Strong plastic

  • Adjustable quick-side release buckle

Mouth for Water Bladder

  • (hydration pack or tube is not included.)

180 Degree Openings

  • 180 Degree Openings for easy packing
  • Easily holds 2 pairs of trainers/footwear, towel, gym clothes, meal prep, and small training tools

Dual Cup Holders

  • The tactical backpack has Cup Holders on both sides of the backpack and can fit 750ml water bottles, umbrellas, or tools.

Water repellent

  • The inner lining material can resist water penetration and protect your items.
  • Note: This backpack cannot prevent heavy rain, or long-term humidity.

  • Has the backpack’s durability been improved?

    Yes! We’ve recently updated the design and material of the backpack to make it even more durable. The new version now includes rip-resistant fabric, making it much stronger and more resistant to wear and tear, especially during heavy use.

  • Is this backpack suitable for carrying heavy gear now?

    Yes! The improved design, including rip-resistant materials and enhanced stitching, makes this backpack more capable of carrying heavy loads without compromising on durability or comfort. It’s ready for any adventure!

  • What if my backpack gets damaged after purchase?

    If your backpack gets damaged or shows signs of wear within the first few months, just send us an email. We will reply within 24 hours to figure out how we can best assist you.

  • How can I get in touch if I need assistance with my backpack?

    We want you to be fully satisfied with your backpack. If something isn't right, please don't hesitate to reach out, and we'll make sure you're taken care of as quickly as possible. Our team is always ready to assist you.

    Been using this as my everyday carry for a while now and it’s held up really well. Fits comfortably on my back even fully loaded — the straps are padded enough that I don’t notice it after a few hours out. Zippers feel sturdy, no snagging or sticking so far, which I was a little worried about given some tactical bags skimp there. Plenty of compartments for organizing smaller stuff (keys, wallet, cables) separately from bigger items, and it doesn’t feel bulky or oversized for everyday use despite how much it can hold. It’s also easy to throw in a car or take on the go without feeling like overkill. For the price, this feels like solid value — good build quality without the markup you’d pay for similar “tactical” branded bags. Would recommend if you want something durable that doesn’t feel like a chore to wear daily.

    I got this backpack for work. I work at one of the local shipyards in my area and have to keep all my personal belongings in it. It allows me to carry all that I need. I carry my lunch box, ear muffs, safety glasses and my hard hat in the main compartment. The second compartment. I can fit my travel Umbrella and a change of clothes. The two front pockets I keep my wallet and other small items.

    Would still recommend this for any blue collar worker that wants a good quality work bag.

Product Description

LHI Tactical Backpack – Military-Grade Rucksack for Hiking, Survival, and Outdoor Adventures

Gear up for any mission, whether it's a tactical operation, hiking trip, or daily use with this premium Tactical Backpack. Engineered for durability and versatility, this military backpack features a high-quality design that supports MOLLE attachments, ensuring you can customize your loadout with additional tactical pouches and utility bags. Perfect for hiking, camping, survival gear, and emergency kits, this rucksack backpack is built to withstand the toughest conditions.

Ideal for outdoor enthusiasts, this backpack for hiking and camping is equipped with hydration system compatibility, making it a top choice for fitness enthusiasts, adventurers, and military professionals. Whether you're exploring the wilderness, hitting the gym, or commuting to campus, this versatile EDC bag serves as your everyday tactical gear companion.

Features:

- MOLLE Webbing for easy attachment of MOLLE pouches and additional gear

- Heavy-duty military-grade materials for rugged durability in all environments

- Hydration compartment for easy access to water on the go

- Spacious compartments to store laptops, books, and college essentials for students

- Designed with tactical survival gear in mind for wilderness survival and bushcraft adventures

- Adjustable shoulder straps and chest straps for comfortable wear during extended use

Why Choose Our Tactical Backpack:

- Built for professionals, outdoor enthusiasts, and military personnel

- Premium tactical gear that offers both functionality and style

- Waterproof, heavy-duty, and expandable for all-weather performance

- Multiple compartments for camping gear, first aid kits, and more

- Perfect for students with college backpacks, university gear, and campus essentials

Whether you're looking for combat gear backpacks, hiking backpacks, or luxury military backpacks, this high-end tactical bag is designed to meet the demands of any adventure or professional need. Tactical backpacks for hiking and survival gear backpacks are just the beginning of what this backpack offers. Get ready to conquer any challenge!
